prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create one finished, striking logo for a company and app named "Sterling". This is a voice-and-camera companion for dialysis care at home. It should feel precise, reassuring, human and contemporary, with enough confidence to extend to other home medical care later.

The visual idea is STERLING SILVER: a beautifully simple closed silver ring, inspired by a plain rounded polished silver band. Make an original sculptural brand symbol, not a photograph of jewellery and not a generic medical logo. A single substantial ring seen at a subtle three-quarter tilt, smooth continuous silhouette, open negative-space center, softly brushed silver with restrained bright highlights and a dark inner edge. A refined hint of an S in the reflection/negative space is welcome only if it stays clean and unmistakably a ring. The ring must work as an independent app symbol.

Composition: one centered vertical logo lockup on a completely plain warm-white background with generous whitespace. Large silver ring symbol above a beautifully typeset wordmark "Sterling". Use custom-feeling clean contemporary typography, slightly rounded geometric letterforms, medium weight, excellent spacing, dark charcoal. Under the wordmark, much smaller exact slogan "keep it clean" in lowercase, with tasteful tracking and strong legibility. Keep the whole lockup compact and balanced. No surrounding frame, no presentation labels, no swatch board, no mockup, no additional logo variations. No medical cross, heart, shield, sparkle icon, hands, catheter, caduceus, blue/green gradients, ornamental flourishes or lens-aperture blades. Avoid mirror-chrome visual noise, excessive 3D effects or large drop shadows.
Text must be exactly "Sterling" and "keep it clean". Spell Sterling S-t-e-r-l-i-n-g. No other text. Crisp edges and professional brand-design finish, landscape canvas.
